diagnosis: Under NamespaceVersioning, the internal version returns all EmployeeCompensation records without filtering by employee. Because the internal namespace URL was mounted on the public gateway with standard JWT authentication, any employee can read all colleagues' salaries by routing through the internal namespace.
exploit_request:
GET /api/internal/compensation/412/ HTTP/1.1
Host: hr.internalportal.net
Authorization: Bearer <junior_employee_jwt>
